close_reason: Wiring completed within PKIX-xji (check call site) and PKIX-9jg (state update call site) — both already committed to chain_walk
description:
## What
Connect the NC state variables, per-cert constraint check, and state-update logic into the chain_walk loop in pkix-path/src/lib.rs.

## Algorithm
In the main chain_walk loop, for each cert at index i:
1. BEFORE processing cert i: run per-cert NC check (PKIX-xji) against current permitted/excluded state
   - If Err → return early with NameConstraintViolation { index: i }
2. AFTER processing cert i (if it's a CA, not the leaf): run NC state update (PKIX-9jg)
   - Update permitted_subtrees and excluded_subtrees from this cert's NC extension

Ordering: RFC 5280 §6.1.4 applies the name check at step (b)(1) and state update at (b)(2) per cert.

## Defensive programming
- Do not wire in if either PKIX-xji or PKIX-9jg are not yet merged — this is the final orchestration step
- Verify loop iteration order matches chain semantics (cert[0]=leaf, cert[n-1]=root-issued CA)

## Acceptance criteria
- Full chain with permitted=[.example.com], EE SAN=foo.example.com → passes
- Full chain with permitted=[.example.com], EE SAN=foo.other.com → Err(NameConstraintViolation)
- chain_walk compiles cleanly with no dead-code warnings
- Depends on: PKIX-9jg (state update), PKIX-xji (per-cert check)
title: Wire NC check+update into chain_walk orchestration
